turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
rmally orders ship out in 1–3 business days, and once the label is created, the tracking email is usually sent around that time 📦

After it ships, delivery is typically 4–8 business days. So total timing is usually 5–11 business days.

If your order included personalization, that adds about 5 extra business days before shipment.

Orders usually arrive on the earlier end of that window, but if you want me to check your specific order, send your order number or checkout email 🙂

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
fer expedited shipping (2–3 business days after it ships) for $15, but it has to be selected at checkout and can't be added after the order is placed. Processing time is still 1–3 business days before shipping, and personalized orders need about 5 extra days before they ship.

If your order is already in process, there unfortunately isn’t a way to speed it up further. If you want, I can check your order status—just send me your order number or the email you used at checkout. 😊

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
at should I do if the tracking never updates?

If the tracking never updates, here’s the best next step:

If it’s been stuck on “label created” or “info received” for 2–3 business days, that’s longer than normal.
If it shows a delivery exception and hasn’t moved for 24+ hours, you should file a claim at https://claims.simplemodern.com
You’ll need your order number when you submit it.

If you want, send me your SM order number and I can tell you whether it’s at that point yet 📦

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
y find your tracking link in the shipping confirmation email we sent after your order shipped 📦

A few places to check:

Your inbox for an email from us with tracking info
Your spam/junk folder
Your order confirmation email, which may also link back to your order status
Your account on simplemodern.com, if you checked out through an account

If you still can’t find it, send me your order number starting with SM or the email used at checkout, and I’ll help with the next step 🙂
